acceptanceCriteria: CEM-V1-032 (docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md) names both consumers of the shared sealed-CEM verifier: `dogfood batch-check` and `dogfood change` (DCW-V0-042 merged/stacked sealed CEMs).
A test shows `dogfood change` refuses a merged sealed cem/1.0 constituent with `constituent-cem-stable-unsupported` before any 0.x decode or verifier runs.
body:
Found while merging origin/main 01f95dbe4 (#804, DCW-V0-042 admitSealedCEMs) into the V1-0632 S1-S3 batch (beamfall/corvint#808, merge 92db2b33d).

main turned the batch constituent verifier into the shared `verifySealedCEM`, which `internal/dogfoodflow/change.go` also calls. #808 puts the CEM-V1-032 stable check in that shared function, so `dogfood change` now refuses a sealed cem/1.0 constituent as `constituent-cem-stable-unsupported` (previously `constituent-cem-invalid`).

Expected: the requirement text and tests cover both callers.
Actual: CEM-V1-032 names only batch-check, and only the batch-check path is tested. The behaviour itself is consistent with the DCW-V0-039 reason rule.
title: CEM-V1-032 stable-constituent refusal now also applies to dogfood change; spec text and test cover only batch-check
